epic.title: Research Efficiencies
epic.overview: Make the research team faster and more efficient by shipping a targeted set of features and bug fixes that eliminate manual workarounds, resolve known platform issues, and improve core survey creation, testing, translation, and results workflows. Each feature in this epic can be released independently.

milestones.title: M1 — Core Logic & Testing Reliability
milestones.overview:
What it delivers: Fixes the structural reliability of piping/logic references, gives researchers a flexible test mode, and adds AI-assisted open-end cleaning.

Features included: Piping & Logic Reference Stability, Enhanced Survey Test Mode, AI-Assisted Admin Cleaning of Open-End Responses.

What done looks like: All three features live with no regressions in existing piping, logic, or test flows.

Dependencies: None blocking start. Produces the Restrictions Review Table (Piping & Logic Reference Stability) that M2's Survey Creator Error Treatment depends on.

milestones.title: M2 — Creator Efficiency & Error Clarity
milestones.overview:
What it delivers: Speeds up survey building itself — bulk question actions, clearer hard-error/soft-warning treatment, precise answer-option-level quota control, and usable Excel exports.

Features included: Notification Bucket Generation Performance, Ability to Multiselect Questions in Survey Creator, Excel Totals — Separate Tabs for Absolutes and Percentages, Question-Level Quota Targeting.

What done looks like: All four features live. Survey Creator Error Treatment's restriction reclassification list agreed jointly with M1's Piping & Logic Reference Stability before either starts.

Dependencies: Survey Creator Error Treatment is blocked until M1's Restrictions Review Table (Piping & Logic Reference Stability) is finalised. Also needs coordination with the in-progress "show all errors" work and any api-core validation changes.

milestones.title: M3 — Platform Fixes & Polish
milestones.overview:
What it delivers: Clears a backlog of smaller, independent bugs — translation import, matrix toggle behaviour, notification performance, and AI insight display.

Features included: Option Groups + Other (Please Specify) Translation Fix, Matrix Question Options Preserved on Choice Type Toggle, "No Insights to Summarise" — Colour Fix and fixing survey creator errors.

What done looks like: All four features live independently — no cross-feature dependencies.

Dependencies: None blocking.

features.title: F2.3 Excel Totals — Separate Tabs for Absolutes and Percentages

The Absolutes tab holds only counts
The Percentages tab holds only percentages
All three tabs share identical headers and ordering
Total-tab data matches the old single-tab numbers exactly
Absolutes and percentages are stored as real numbers, not text
